connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package whoop-ai-mcp. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the shashankswe2020-ux account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
